description: This file defines API endpoints for managing notes in a notes application, including creating, listing, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes using FastAPI and SQLAlchemy ORM.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI's router class used to group related API endpoints.

methods.name: schemas.NoteOut create_note(payload: schemas.NoteCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Creates a new note with a title and content, returning the created note.

methods.name: list[schemas.NoteOut] list_notes(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all notes.

methods.name: schemas.NoteOut get_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by its ID.

methods.name: schemas.NoteOut update_note(note_id: int, payload: schemas.NoteUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Updates the title and/or content of an existing note by its ID.

methods.name: None delete_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID.
